fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM104,260. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0057136/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: A pass in STPM with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any two (2) subjects; A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid; A Certificate in Matriculation or Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; A Diploma (Level 4, MQF) in the relevant fields with at least CGPA of 2.00; A Diploma Kemahiran Malaysia (DKM) / Diploma Lanjutan Kemahiran Malaysia (DLKM) / Diploma Vokasional Malaysia (DVM) subjected to HEP Senate / Academic Board’s approval; An Advanced Diploma (Level 5, MQF) in the relevant fields with at least CGPA of 2.00; Other relevant equivalent qualifications recognised by Malaysian Government.
